انحسموا (form VII)
# اِنْحَسَمُوا (inḥasamū) /in.ħa.sa.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْحَسَمَ (inḥasama)
# اِنْحَسِمُوا (inḥasimū) /in.ħa.si.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْحَسَمَ (inḥasama)
